Olive cable-knit wool cardigan/tan elbow patches/pale blue collar/deep brown full-length trousers/broad black leather rubber-soled shoes. Mature expressive Disco Elysium meets Berlin painted planes, dry-brush oil marks, weathered asymmetry, dirty ochre and muted cool petrol/gray-green shadows, no glossy toy treatment.
ONE battered burgundy briefcase with brass clasp remains held low BY ITS HANDLE in ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND at right outer thigh/knee in all four views. Left hand empty and relaxed. Front-right bag near visible side viewer-left; rear-right bag near side viewer-left; rear-left bag far side viewer-right; front-left bag far side viewer-right.
